description: Commit 26 — Verification queue at /dashboard/admin/queue. Lists PENDING blood requests sorted critical-first (highest urgency descending). Admin can verify a request (moves it to VERIFIED, alerts donors) or cancel it. Server actions verifyRequest and cancelRequest added to src/app/actions/admin.ts. Page is a Server Component; the row actions use a 'use client' QueueActions component with ConfirmDialog.
steps: 1. Extend src/lib/admin.ts: add four new methods to `adminApi`. Import `BloodRequest, Hospital, UserProfile, AuditLog, Payment, Paginated` from `@/types` and `apiPaginated` from `./api`. New methods: `queue: (token: string, query?: { page?: number; limit?: number }) => apiPaginated<BloodRequest[]>('/admin/requests/pending', { token, cache: 'no-store', query })` — fetches PENDING requests for the verification queue; `verifyRequest: (token: string, id: string) => api<BloodRequest>('/admin/requests/' + id + '/verify', { method: 'PATCH', token, cache: 'no-store' })` — verifies a request; `cancelRequest: (token: string, id: string) => api<BloodRequest>('/admin/requests/' + id + '/cancel', { method: 'PATCH', token, cache: 'no-store' })` — cancels a request. Keep the existing analytics and timeSeries methods unchanged.

2. Create src/app/actions/admin.ts with `'use server'` at top. Import `revalidatePath` from `next/cache`, `redirect` from `next/navigation`, `ApiError` from `@/lib/api`, `adminApi` from `@/lib/admin`, `getSession` from `@/lib/session`. Export `type ActionResult = { error: string } | { ok: true }`. Add a private `adminToken()` helper: `const session = await getSession(); if (!session || session.user.role !== 'ADMIN') redirect('/auth/login?next=/dashboard/admin'); return session.accessToken;`. Implement three exported async functions: `verifyRequest(requestId: string): Promise<ActionResult>` — calls `adminApi.verifyRequest(token, requestId)`, then `revalidatePath('/dashboard/admin/queue')` and `revalidatePath('/dashboard/admin', 'layout')`, returns `{ ok: true }`; `cancelRequest(requestId: string): Promise<ActionResult>` — same but calls `adminApi.cancelRequest`, same revalidatePaths; `verifyHospital(hospitalId: string): Promise<ActionResult>` — calls `adminApi.verifyHospital(token, hospitalId)`, revalidates `'/dashboard/admin/hospitals'` and `'/dashboard/admin'`, returns `{ ok: true }`. Wrap all calls in try/catch returning `{ error: messageFor(error) }` where `messageFor` mirrors the pattern from src/app/actions/hospital.ts.

3. Extend src/lib/admin.ts with the `verifyHospital` method needed by the action above: `verifyHospital: (token: string, id: string) => api<Hospital>('/admin/hospitals/' + id + '/verify', { method: 'PATCH', token, cache: 'no-store' })`. Also add `banUser` and `unbanUser` methods now (they'll be used in FEAT-003, but adding them here keeps admin.ts complete): `banUser: (token: string, userId: string) => api<UserProfile>('/admin/users/' + userId + '/ban', { method: 'PATCH', token, cache: 'no-store' })` and `unbanUser: (token: string, userId: string) => api<UserProfile>('/admin/users/' + userId + '/unban', { method: 'PATCH', token, cache: 'no-store' })`. Import `UserProfile` from `@/types`.

4. Create src/app/dashboard/admin/queue/page.tsx as an async Server Component. Metadata `{ title: 'Verification queue' }`. Read `searchParams` (typed as `Promise>`), parse `page` from it (default 1). Fetch `adminApi.queue(session.accessToken, { page, limit: 20 })`. Render: Eyebrow 'Verification queue' + h1 'Pending requests'. Show total count. For each request in `data`, render a `` component (created in next step). If `data.length === 0`, show an empty state: `

Queue is clear

No requests awaiting verification.

`. Add pagination links at the bottom: show Prev/Next links using `` pointing to `?page=N` if N is valid. Import `adminApi` from `@/lib/admin`, `getSession` from `@/lib/session`, `ButtonLink` from `@/components/ui/button`, `Eyebrow` from `@/components/ui/eyebrow`.

5. Create src/app/dashboard/admin/queue/components/queue-row.tsx as a `'use client'` component. Props: `request: BloodRequest` (import from `@/types`). Import `verifyRequest, cancelRequest` from `@/app/actions/admin`, `ConfirmDialog` from `@/components/ui/confirm-dialog`, `EmergencyBadge, StatusBadge` from `@/components/ui/badge`, `Button` from `@/components/ui/button`, `Spinner` from `@/components/ui/spinner`, `bloodGroupLabel` from `@/lib/blood`, `timeAgo, unitsLabel` from `@/lib/format`, `toast` from `sonner`, `useTransition, useState` from `react`. State: `confirmAction: 'verify' | 'cancel' | null`. Use `useTransition` for pending state. The row layout: `<div className='flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-[24px] border border-ink/10 bg-cream p-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between'>`. Left side: blood group tile `<div className='grid size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-[16px] bg-blush text-blood text-lg font-extrabold'>` showing `bloodGroupLabel[request.bloodGroup]`, then hospital name + address + `timeAgo(request.createdAt)` + `unitsLabel(request.unitsNeeded)` + `<EmergencyBadge urgency={request.urgency} />`. Right side: two buttons — `<Button variant='forest' size='sm' onClick={() => setConfirmAction('verify')}>Verify</Button>` and `<Button variant='outline' size='sm' onClick={() => setConfirmAction('cancel')}>Cancel</Button>`, both disabled while `isPending`. When `confirmAction === 'verify'`, mount `<ConfirmDialog title='Verify this request?' confirmLabel='Verify' onConfirm={async () => { startTransition(async () => { const r = await verifyRequest(request.id); if ('error' in r) { toast.error(r.error); } else { toast.success('Request verified — donors alerted.'); } setConfirmAction(null); }); }} onClose={() => setConfirmAction(null)} pending={isPending}>` with body text 'This will move the request to Verified and notify compatible donors.' When `confirmAction === 'cancel'`, mount `<ConfirmDialog title='Cancel this request?' confirmLabel='Cancel request' tone='danger' ...>` with body 'This permanently cancels the request. The hospital can post a new one.'. Export as `QueueRow`.

6. Create src/app/dashboard/admin/queue/loading.tsx: export default `QueueLoading()` returning `
Loading verification queue…
{Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, i) =>
)}
`.
7. Commit: `git add src/lib/admin.ts src/app/actions/admin.ts src/app/dashboard/admin/queue/ && git commit -m 'feat: add verification queue sorted by emergency'`
